units.now: {el} brings Action this month, at a level your chart neither craves nor resents. Income and effort hold their usual pace through the weeks, asking nothing extra of you.
{el} brings Action this month, adding fuel to work you already do well. Money and effort move in step, while more of the work around you comes your way.
findings: MAJOR month:F01: "as the weeks look after you"; "as others start to count on you"; "work you already do well"; "Ease with them returns after a long while"; "Each evening brings you back to a calmer house"; "holds firm. Steadier support stands behind your tasks" | The rule is now AM1, but the welcome energies and the soft bonds still settle the month in the reader's favour, praise the reader's skill ("carry well", "do well"), or claim a history no chart holds ("after a long while", "a talent you have shown before"). The hard bonds already follow the rule (pattern 3). The soft ones do not, so on a grow + bind page (M026, M056, M083, M085) the reader is told twice that the month goes well. The Pattern's P11 failure ("things are flowing for you") is the same one. | Rule: a welcome energy or a soft bond names what arrives and what it asks of the reader (time, care, an answer). It never names the result, the reader's skill or the past. Rebuild the nine units listed. Replacement texts are proposed in F02–F10.

units.now: {el} brings Action for a whole year, a steady current through your working life. Neither a great leap nor a great loss arrives, only steady building at your own rate.
{el} brings Action for a whole year, the reach your chart holds and still wants. Each season opens a fresh field to work in, asking more of your effort.
{el} brings Action for a whole year, more reach than your chart is built for. Chances pull at you from every side, each one taking a share of your strength.
{el} brings Action for a whole year, one your chart has long wanted. Your reach stretches into new places, asking you to build something there that lasts.
{el} brings more Body for a whole year, a steady flow of your own energy. It neither crowds nor empties you, keeping your stride sure from spring to winter.
{el} brings more Body for a whole year, a strength that weighs on your chart. Others give way to you often, while the year shows where your force stops helping.
{el} brings more Body for a whole year, the strength your chart wants. Footing grows solid as the seasons turn, asking you to stand on your own.
{el} brings Expression for a whole year, at a level your chart holds without strain. Your voice stays your own, giving out as much as you mean and no more.
{el} brings Expression for a whole year, building on how well you already speak and make. Craft grows sharper with use, asking more hours of your hands each season.
{el} brings Expression for a whole year, an outlet that weighs on your chart. Pleasure and talk fill your calendar, drawing off strength you need for yourself.
{el} brings Expression for a whole year, an outlet your chart goes without. Through the seasons your voice grows bolder, asking you to speak in places you kept quiet.
{el} brings Mind for a whole year, in a measure that leaves you as you are. Support arrives when it is due, with no need for you to wait or lean.
{el} brings Mind for a whole year, more of what already feeds you well. Skills you started long ago take root, as your own judgement gains weight.
{el} brings Mind for a whole year, a comfort your chart does better without. Caution settles on you like a thick coat, holding you still until you are sure.
{el} brings Mind for a whole year, the support your chart keeps asking for. Teachers, books and quiet hours come your way, each asking for your time.
{el} brings Order for a whole year, a balanced share of rules and duty. Obligations neither grow nor shrink, asking you to carry them as you always have.
{el} brings Order for a whole year, more of the pressure that shapes you well. Responsibility gathers around you season by season, with others looking to you to hold it.
{el} brings Order for a whole year, pressure that works against your chart. The year tests your patience often, pressing on you from more sides than you can answer.
{el} brings Order for a whole year, a firmness your chart has long gone without. Pressure comes from outside through the seasons, asking you to hold your shape under it.
